cost_curve_bps.role: diagnostic; already reported at discovery via G11
cost_curve_bps.trade_set: IDENTICAL to the primary; cost scenarios never regenerate signals

holding_bars.rationale: the mechanism asserts a transient reversal; the grid probes whether the effect is confined to a narrow horizon. It may not be used to pick a different holding period.

participation_reference_length_days.rationale: the 30-day same-slot reference is the only length-like constant in the hypothesis; the grid probes whether the result is an artifact of exactly 30 days. It may not be used to pick a different reference length.

oos_deferred_with_reason: the ARC-03 dataset is a single certified 5m authority over one common causal window; a held-out out-of-sample period cannot be frozen without splitting the discovery window, which would change the primary trade set. The out-of-sample requirement is therefore deferred to the authorized ARC03_ROBUSTNESS_OOS_01 stage, where a walk-forward protocol must be frozen BEFORE execution and all primary parameters remain at their frozen values.
post_hoc_rule: POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY - it may never be promoted and requires a NEW_HYPOTHESIS_ID and a NEW_PREREGISTRATION to be tested as anything other than a robustness diagnostic
precondition: runs ONLY if the primary discovery returns DISCOVERY_PASS (all critical gates pass and no control satisfies all gates)
